biggest_catch: The reward is referrer-only — the friend gets nothing — and the friend must sign up as a NEW AUTOMATIC DELIVERY customer (not will-call) for the $50 credit to post.
catches: $50 credit stated for the referrer only; no friend-side reward is stated.
Credit applies only when the referral signs up as a new automatic delivery Bioheat home heating oil or propane customer — will-call sign-ups do not qualify.
Credit is applied to the fuel account, not paid as cash.
Program details are published as a blog post rather than a dedicated terms page; confirm the current offer before acting.
